challenge.method: Check the source ordering and independently test prefix boundaries, supplementary Unicode code units, segment limits, all separator forms, trimmed matching, the first marker replacement, and the comment-removal regex on the actual shipped module.
challenge.results: A complete token at code-unit 256 matched while one reaching the 257th did not. The 30th segment matched and the 31st did not. Further tests confirm exact trimmed membership, the specified delimiter choices, and the written replacements with their actual limits.

limitations: The helper inspects a prefix and can recognize a token after the first line. Normalization is a single first match, and the written block-comment regex does not span newlines.
